rule.reference: MSL 4.1 table 8.2: x + y correctly rounded
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: x - y correctly rounded
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: x * y correctly rounded
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: x / y <= 2.5 ulp for y in [2^-126, 2^126]
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: exp2(x) <= 3 + floor(fabs(2 * x)) ulp, |x| < 0.5
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: log2(x) absolute error <= 2^-22 for x in [0.5, 2]
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: log2(x) <= 2 ulp for x > 0 outside [0.5, 2]
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: sin(x) absolute error <= 2^-13 for x in [-pi, pi]
MSL 4.1 table 8.2: cos(x) absolute error <= 2^-13 for x in [-pi, pi]
MSL 4.1 table 8.1: x / y correctly rounded

title: Single-precision operations against the accuracy stated in MSL tables 8.1 and 8.2
